svg.title: Hollowmere arena map preview (720 x 1280 phone, arena 720 x 760, camera zoom 1.3)
svg.desc: Drawn from game/data/arena_map.json by arena-map-preview.py; colours are the ART-BIBLE tokens. You are a teal circle, them a coral flat-top hexagon, Stoneback a gold rhombus (the hexagon means "them"). Guard towers are dimmer: scenery, never counted. Labels are 24 px Bold with a 5 px VOID outline. Header, text strip and buttons are placeholders for layout only.
